about: BCS-W (2026-11-25): Electrical v75 = v74 + ONLY these texts (owner R1 / R2 24 Nov 13:09 - 13:12, the approved mockup board 1 / 2 (23:33), Question 1 answers 1a / 3a / 4a (2026-11-25 00:20)). Each entry names the step by its keys (all equal), the text it replaces (checked against v74 by the mint: `old`, null = the step had no line of its own and showed a stock phrase) and the new text. Read by scripts/_instruments/mint_electrical_v75_bcsw.py and its tests. The supply cost lines are NOT here: bcs_derive.py's wording table writes them when the cost pipelines are generated.

price_steps.old: BoQ multiplier per the sheet (discount 0.5, markup 0.4 folded)
price_steps.new: List price less the discount, plus the supply markup (the 'Conduit discount & supply markup' input).
List price less the 'Junction box discount', plus the 'Junction box supply markup', rounded up to the next 10.

price_steps.old: BoQ = the catalogue rate PLUS a 30% markup (owner 2026-09-04: 'the rate is BCS and it should be marked up by 1.3 for BoQ'). *** THIS IS THE INVERSE OF THE ORIGINAL DESIGN, which had the catalogue rate AS the BoQ rate and BCS = rate / 1.3. The hand-priced data falsified it: of 26 rows matched at >=0.60, SIXTEEN land EXACTLY on 1.25 or 1.30 ABOVE the catalogue rate. *** THE FACTOR IS 1.3 EITHER WAY, so a build with the division restored looks correct and under-quotes every row by ~23%. Worked: BOQ-26-00118 r6, Lutron 24,500 -> BoQ 31,850, BCS 24,500.

remarks.cable_arm: We buy armoured cable at {%discount} off list and quote at +{%supply_markup}. Example: a 4-core aluminium armoured cable listed at Rs 1,217/m is quoted at Rs {rs:1217*(1-discount)*(1+supply_markup)}/m.{bcs}It costs us Rs {rs:1217*(1-discount)*(1+wastage)}/m: the same discount, plus {%wastage} wastage instead of the markup. The wastage is cable bought and not billed - offcuts and pulling losses.
remarks.cable_unarm: We buy unarmoured cable at {%discount} off list and quote at +{%supply_markup}. Example: a cable listed at Rs 100/m is quoted at Rs {rs2:100*(1-discount)*(1+supply_markup)}/m.{bcs}It costs us Rs {rs2:100*(1-discount)*(1+wastage)}/m: the same discount, plus {%wastage} wastage instead of the markup. The wastage is cable bought and not billed - offcuts and pulling losses.
remarks.conduit: We buy conduit at {%discount} off list and quote at +{%supply_markup}. Example: a PVC 32 mm conduit listed at Rs 100/m is quoted at Rs {rs:100*(1-discount)*(1+supply_markup)}/m.{bcs}It costs us Rs {rs:100*(1-discount)}/m: the same discount, no markup.
remarks.gland: We buy glands at {%discount} off list and quote at +{%supply_markup}. Example: a 2-core armoured aluminium gland listed at Rs 203.75 is quoted at Rs {rs2:203.75*(1-discount)*(1+supply_markup)}.{bcs}It costs us Rs {rs2:203.75*(1-discount)}: the same discount, no markup.
remarks.lug: We buy lugs at {%discount} off list and quote at +{%supply_markup}. Example: a 4-core unarmoured aluminium lug listed at Rs 71.66 is quoted at Rs {rs2:71.66*(1-discount)*(1+supply_markup)}.{bcs}It costs us Rs {rs2:71.66*(1-discount)}: the same discount, no markup.
remarks.swsock: We buy switches, sockets, plates, blanks and back boxes at {%discount} off list and quote at +{%supply_markup}. Example: a 16A 1-Way Switch with Indicator listed at Rs 403 is quoted at Rs {rs:403*(1-discount)*(1+supply_markup)}.{bcs}It costs us Rs {rs:403*(1-discount)}: the same discount, no markup.
remarks.switchgear: We buy switchgear at {%discount} off list and quote at +{%supply_markup}. Example: a 63A RCCB 30mA (FP) listed at Rs 6,288 is quoted at Rs {rs:6288*(1-discount)*(1+supply_markup)}.{bcs}It costs us Rs {rs:6288*(1-discount)}: the same discount, no markup.
remarks.indsock: We buy industrial sockets at {%discount} off list and quote at +{%supply_markup}. Example: a Plug + Socket in Enclosure Box listed at Rs 12,530 is quoted at Rs {rs:12530*(1-discount)*(1+supply_markup)} - the discount and the margin nearly cancel, which is intended.
remarks.tray_supply: The margin on a cable tray's supply rate. A Ladder, MS powder-coated tray at Rs 290/m is quoted at Rs {rs2:290*(1+supply_markup)}/m.
remarks.earthing_supply: The margin on earthing supply. A GI 50 x 10 mm earth strip at Rs 312 is quoted at Rs {rs2:312*(1+supply_markup)}.
remarks.lms_supply: An LMS catalogue rate is our cost. The quote is the rate + {%supply_markup}, rounded up to the nearest 10. A Rs 24,500 Lutron panel is quoted at Rs {rs10:24500*(1+supply_markup)}.
remarks.lms_bcs: {bcs}An LMS catalogue rate is our cost, plus {%bcs_markup}. The Rs 24,500 Lutron panel costs us Rs {rs:24500*(1+bcs_markup)}. Raise this and every LMS cost rises.
remarks.jb_supply: The margin on a junction box. A 250 mm face box lists at Rs 410 and is quoted at Rs {rs2:410*(1+supply_markup)}.
remarks.tray_cutting: The margin on the floor-cutting charge. Rs 200/m of cutting is billed at Rs {rs:200*(1+installation_markup)}/m.
remarks.cable_install: A stored cable install cost is billed with a {%installation_markup} markup. A 4-core copper armoured cable's Rs 22/m install cost is billed at Rs {rs:22*(1+installation_markup)}/m.
remarks.earthing_install: A stored earthing install cost takes a {%installation_markup} margin. A CU 32 x 3 mm strip's Rs 44 install cost is billed at Rs {rs2:44*(1+installation_markup)}.
remarks.tray_install: A cable tray's stored install rate is billed with a {%installation_markup} margin. A Perforated GI 1.2 mm tray's Rs 220/m is billed at Rs {rs:220*(1+installation_markup)}/m. Raise this and every tray install rate rises with it.
remarks.misc_supply: A Misc catalogue rate is the quote.{bcs}Our cost is {%ratio} of it. Rubber Mat quotes Rs 3,200 and costs Rs {rs:3200*ratio}.
remarks.misc_install: A Misc install rate is the quote.{bcs}Our cost is {%ratio} of it (Misc labour is carried in the per-sqft figure). Rubber Mat's Rs 500 install costs Rs {rs:500*ratio}.
remarks.popup_supply: A pop-up box's per-module rate is the quote.{bcs}Our cost is {%ratio} of it. Rs 900/module quoted costs us Rs {rs:900*ratio}.
remarks.popup_install: A pop-up box's per-module install rate is the quote.{bcs}Our cost is {%ratio} of it. Rs 100/module quoted costs us Rs {rs:100*ratio}.
remarks.termination_share: Installing a termination set is {%share} of its supply price. A Rs 165.50 set gives Rs {rs2:165.5*share}.
remarks.db_share: Installing a DB is {%share} of the whole assembly, not just the shell. A Rs 3,113 assembly gives Rs {rs:3113*share}.
remarks.popup_module_share: Installing a pop-up box's modules is {%share} of their supply price. A Rs 146 module gives Rs {rs2:146*share}.
remarks.swsock_share: Installing a switch or socket is {%share} of its supply price. A Rs 146 switch gives Rs {rs2:146*share}.
remarks.indsock_share: Installing an industrial socket is {%share} of its supply price. A Rs 12,279 socket gives Rs {rs:12279*share}.
remarks.pw_switch_share: Installing the switch inside a point is {%share} of its supply price. A Rs 146 switch gives Rs {rs2:146*share}.
remarks.pw_accessory_share: Installing the socket, plate, blank or back box inside a point is {%share} of its supply price. A Rs 146 accessory gives Rs {rs2:146*share}.
remarks.jb_share: Installing a junction box is {%share} of its supply price. A Rs 594.50 box gives Rs {rs2:594.5*share}.
remarks.conduit_share: Installing a conduit is {%share} of its supply price, wherever that conduit sits. Rs 70/m gives Rs {rs:70*share}/m.
remarks.tray_accessories: The rods, channels and bolts a ceiling-mounted tray needs. A 10 m ceiling run adds Rs {rs:10*amount}; a floor run adds nothing.
remarks.tray_refilling: Refilling a floor trench, when asked for. A 10 m trench adds Rs {rs:10*amount}.
remarks.tray_cutting_amount: Cutting the floor, when asked for. A 10 m cut adds Rs {rs:10*amount}.
remarks.tray_discount: The discount we get off the cable tray list price, now {%discount}; with no discount the without-cover and cover-only columns are our actual buying price.
remarks.jb_discount: The discount we get off the junction box list price, now {%discount}; with no discount the list-price column is our actual buying price.
remarks.elec_bcs_install_per_sqft: {bcs}Our installation cost for an Electrical BoQ = this x the project's area in square feet. Read by the BoQ summary, not by any category's rule.
